if needs_trailing_slash
            path << '/'
          end

          if block
            if app
              raise 'You must specify either app or block in the same time'
            else
              handler = block
            end
          else
            if app
              handler = app
            else
              raise 'You must specify either app or block in the same time'
            end
          end

          if @logger
            if @logger.respond_to?(:debug)
              begin
                wrapped_logger = Fluent::Log::ConsoleAdapter.wrap(@logger)
                if wrapped_logger.respond_to?(:level)
                  if wrapped_logger.respond_to?(:debug?)
                    if wrapped_logger.debug?
                      debug_enabled = true
                    else
                      debug_enabled = false
                    end
                  else
                    debug_enabled = true
                  end
                else
                  debug_enabled = true
                end
              rescue
                wrapped_logger = nil
                debug_enabled = false
              end
            else
              debug_enabled = false
            end
          else
            debug_enabled = false
          end

          if debug_enabled
            if allows_request_body
              if query_string
                @logger.debug("mount #{method_label} #{path} query=#{query_string}")
              else
                @logger.debug("mount #{method_label} #{path}")
              end
            else
              if parsed_query
                @logger.debug("mount #{method_label} #{path} parsed_query=#{parsed_query}")
              else
                @logger.debug("mount #{method_label} #{path}")
              end
            end
          end

          routing_table = @router.instance_variable_get(:@router)
          method_routes = routing_table[canonical_name]
          if method_routes.include?(path)
            raise "#{path} is already mounted"
          else
            method_routes[path] = handler
          end
        end

        [:get, :head, :post, :put, :patch, :delete, :connect, :options, :trace].each do |name|
          define_method(name) do |path, app = nil, &block|
            add_handler(name, path, app, &block)
          end
        end
      end
    end
  end
end

display.text:
@logger.debug('Start webrick HTTP server listening')
            @server.start
          end

          def stop
            @server.shutdown
            @server.stop
          end

          HttpServer::Methods::ALL.map { |e| e.downcase.to_sym }.each do |name|
            define_method(name) do |path, app = nil, &block|
              if (block && app) || (!block && !app)
                raise 'You must specify either app or block in the same time'
              end

              # Do not build a handler class here to able to handle multiple methods for single path.
              @methods << [path, name, app || block]
            end
          end

          private

          def build_handler
            @methods.group_by(&:first).each do |(path, rest)|
              klass = Fluent::PluginHelper::HttpServer::Compat::WebrickHandler.build(**Hash[rest.map { |e| [e[1], e[2]] }])
              @server.mount(path, klass)
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  end
end
